notes.title: Lucky Dog 1 update
notes.notes:
We've released a patch that fixes the following:

Typos

Fixed 100% completion CGs not being unlocked

Fixed some system images missing transparency data

Fixed looping sound effect

Fixed misaligned morgue route choice

Fixed error message when LuckyPoint is negative

All files in this update will be automatically distributed to all Steam users.
